---
title: "simstim host join"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Prepare this machine from a laptop invite on standard input.

```text
simstim host join [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
simstim host join
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--ac-awake` | on a Mac, explicitly allow the displayed AC sleep change |
| `--account <string>` | the new or existing non-root login account (default: `simstim`) |
| `--address <strings>` | an address the laptop can reach (repeat for more than one) |
| `--agent-user <string>` | on a Mac, the existing account for explicit user-agent mode |
| `--cpus <int>` | on a Mac, the CPUs for its Linux VM |
| `--memory <size>` | on a Mac, the memory for its Linux VM, such as 8G |
| `--port <uint16>` | the machine's outer SSH port (default: `22`) |
| `--start-mode <string>` | on a Mac, daemon or user-agent (default: daemon) |
| `-y`, `--yes` | answer yes to every question: make the displayed machine changes without asking |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |

Part of [`host`](host.md): add, create, list, test and remove hosts.
